title: General Practice: reflection and OSCE prompts

questions.q: Describe a consultation that went well. Which Calgary-Cambridge element made the difference?
questions.answer: Model: name the element, give a specific example, state what to repeat.

questions.q: OSCE: Take a history from a patient with a 2-week cough.
questions.answer: Model: open question, SOCRATES-style cough details, red flags (haemoptysis, weight loss), smoking, ICE, summarise, safety-net.

questions.q: What safety-netting advice would I give for a self-limiting illness?
questions.answer: Model: expected course, specific warning signs, when and how to seek help.
